diff --git a/test/units/cli/test_doc.py b/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
index d93b5aa..acf9ef0 100644
--- a/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
+++ b/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ __metaclass__ = type
 
 import pytest
 
-from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI, RoleMixin
 
 
 TTY_IFY_DATA = {
@@ -33,3 +33,49 @@ TTY_IFY_DATA = {
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('text, expected', sorted(TTY_IFY_DATA.items()))
 def test_ttyify(text, expected):
     assert DocCLI.tty_ify(text) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('collection, expected_name', [
+    (None, 'example'),
+    ('', 'example'),
+    ('namespace.collection', 'namespace.collection.example'),
+])
+def test_build_role_doc(collection, expected_name):
+    role = RoleMixin()
+    main = {'short_description': 'Main', 'options': {'value': {'type': 'str'}}}
+    alternate = {'short_description': 'Alternate'}
+    argspec = {'main': main, 'alternate': alternate}
+    path = '/roles/example'
+
+    fqcn, doc = role._build_doc('example', path, collection, argspec)
+    assert fqcn == expected_name
+    assert doc == {'path': path, 'collection': collection, 'entry_points': argspec}
+    assert doc['entry_points']['main'] is main
+
+    fqcn, doc = role._build_doc('example', path, collection, argspec, 'alternate')
+    assert fqcn == expected_name
+    assert doc == {'path': path, 'collection': collection, 'entry_points': {'alternate': alternate}}
+    assert doc['entry_points']['alternate'] is alternate
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('argspec, entry_point', [({}, None), ({'main': {'short_description': 'Main'}}, 'missing')])
+def test_build_role_doc_without_matching_entry_points(argspec, entry_point):
+    assert RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', 'namespace.collection', argspec, entry_point) == (
+        'namespace.collection.example', None)
+
+
+def test_build_role_doc_preserves_empty_spec():
+    assert RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', '', {'main': None}) == (
+        'example', {'path': '/roles/example', 'collection': '', 'entry_points': {'main': None}})
+
+
+def test_create_role_doc_omits_roles_without_matching_entry_points(monkeypatch):
+    role = RoleMixin()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(role, '_find_all_normal_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: {('example', '/roles/example')})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(role, '_find_all_collection_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: set())
+    spec = {'main': {'short_description': 'Main'}}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(role, '_load_argspec', lambda *args, **kwargs: spec)
+
+    assert role._create_role_doc(('example',), ('/roles',), entry_point='missing') == {}
+    assert role._create_role_doc(('example',), ('/roles',), entry_point='main') == {
+        'example': {'path': '/roles/example', 'collection': '', 'entry_points': spec}}
